items.title: Lockheed Martin (LMT) Completes First Japan ASEV In Indo Pacific Defense Milestone
items.summary: Lockheed Martin (NYSE:LMT) has completed the first fully integrated Aegis System Equipped Vessel for Japan, marking a new milestone for Indo Pacific missile defense. The ASEV program is designed to strengthen Japan's maritime air and missile defense capabilities and support cooperation with allied forces.
